Hi Alex — adding a few technical clarifications so the signal map matches runtime behavior: 

- Tracing hooks: instrument at request entry, model dispatch, token-stream start, and third-party retrievals. We recommend a root span per API request and child spans per model invocation.
- Sampling: set 100% for debug sessions; default to 1% global with route-level overrides for business-critical routes (e.g., /generate/invoice).
- KV cache evictions should emit a metric (redwood.kv.eviction.count) and a span annotation when eviction causes increased latency.
- Error taxonomy: include fields error_type (generation|runtime|quota|validation|policy) and error_phase (prefill|decode|post-process).

I made inline notes on the attached signal map and flagged two places where HarborAI will need to add a correlation_id at ingest to join traces to app logs.

Questions for workshop:
- Do you plan to route model failures back to users (400-with-reason) or always hide and return fallback?
- Expected peak RPS for staging — this affects alert thresholds.

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
